a: Respect for elders is an important cultural value in many Nigerian communities.
Greetings often matter before business talk.
Jollof rice is a beloved West African dish with national pride attached.
Pounded yam is often eaten with soups like egusi.
Football is widely followed across the country.
Nigeria has large Christian and Muslim populations and other faiths.
Hundreds of languages are spoken; English unifies official communication.
Open-air markets remain central to commerce in many cities.
Tech hubs and coworking spaces support startups especially in Lagos and Abuja.
Remote and distributed work has grown with better connectivity.
